evidence: Touches contrib/guix files and carries the 'Build system' label, affecting Guix release tooling.
rationale: Fixes a build failure in `guix-codesign` when building from source without substitutes on fast machines. As noted in the description, 'With substitutes disabled, guix-codesign can fail when building oscrypto 1.3.0. The test_dump_private test raises ZeroDivisionError.'
